_comment: Mac states and labels the Mac-vs-Lulo robot (scripts/robot/mac/diff.py) never reports as gaps: Apple-account services and OS chrome Lulo deliberately leaves out. `path` is an fnmatch pattern over the state path; with `label` only that control or menu item is allowed. tests/inventory/allowlist.json labels apply too. Add rows only with a reason a reviewer can check.

entries.reason: Apple Account sign-in is an Apple service; Lulo has local accounts (docs/parity.md, Settings Mac-only list).
Family Sharing is an Apple Account service.
Game Center is an Apple service.
Wallet and Apple Pay are Apple services with protected card storage.
AppleCare coverage is Apple's warranty service.
Lulo's equivalent is Login Password (fingerprint where the hardware has it); compared under SET rows, not by pane name.
Apple Intelligence and Siri are Apple services; Lulo Intelligence is its own pane, tracked separately.
Opens macOS Internet Accounts in System Settings (another app); Lulo routes accounts through Settings ▸ Internet Accounts.
macOS window-tab overview (AppKit tabbing); Lulo windows have no system tab bar.
Opens the Notes app's Maths Notes on the Mac (another app); Lulo opens its own Maths Notes window, compared by hand.

entries.label: Synchronise All Accounts
entries.reason: iCloud/Exchange account synchronisation; Lulo syncs IMAP/Graph accounts automatically.
⌘Tab cannot be walked on Lulo's nested session (niri runs key binds only for physical keyboards); covered by run_lulo scenarios.
The Mac's Apps (Launchpad) Dock tile; Lulo's Apps grid is a separate surface, checked by run_menu_dismiss.py.

entries.label: Services
entries.reason: macOS Services submenu (system-wide app extensions); OS chrome.

entries.label: Full-Screen Tile
entries.reason: Split View tiling is tracked by WIN-01 (Partial).
